messages:

Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: updated milestone allocations & approval runway

Jordan —

Following our call this morning I attached a refreshed MAP (proposed_map_v2.xlsx) that quantifies the remaining approval runway and calls out where the close date is most at risk. Key points: 

- Risk areas: procurement approval (Procurement packet outstanding), security review (SOC evidence requested), integration demo availability.
- Quantified impact: if procurement approval slips >7 days, expected close slips by 10–14 days; if security review requires an additional audit window, extra 2–3 weeks possible.
- Short-term mitigations included in sheet: prioritized demo, pre-populated procurement packet, and dedicated CS reviewer.

Ask: can you confirm by EOD Tuesday (2 Jun) whether Procurement will accept the standard SOW or require redlines? If they require redlines, please share the schedule for legal review so we can align resources.

Attachments: proposed_map_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@novacorp.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: updated milestone allocations & approval runway

Marcus —

Thanks for the updated MAP and the clarity. Two quick notes from our side after internal sync: 

1) Procurement will likely ask for two small commercial changes to the SOW (payment milestone timing + liability cap). They asked to include legal on any redlines; I looped them here.
2) We still need to validate integration schedule with our Platform team; they prefer a demo in the week of June 7 to validate acceptance criteria.

Can you provide a cost delta if we pursue an accelerated demo and escrow of engineering time (i.e., guaranteed demo slot within 48–72h)? Also, if Procurement must redline, what is your typical turnaround to provide a redlined SOW back to them?

Jordan Ellis
Head of Partnerships | NovaCorp
jordan.ellis@novacorp.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@novacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: updated milestone allocations & approval runway

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Forwarding your note to Legal (Neha) and CS (Monica / Rachel). High-level responses below; see attached cost_impact_summary.pdf for estimates: 

- Accelerated demo (48–72h guaranteed slot): we can prioritize this for a one-time success fee of $6,000 — covers dedicated engineering time and priority scheduling. Demo content will include the integration checklist and two end-to-end scenarios.
- Redlines: if Procurement provides redlines, our typical internal turnaround to review and return an initial redline is 2 business days; Neha can confirm. Major redline negotiations could add 5–7 business days depending on complexity.

Mitigation options we recommend (ranked):
1) Option A (maintain current close) — Accept accelerated demo + procurement agrees to limited commercial redlines; requires sign-off on SOW within 7 business days.
2) Option B (rebaseline + conditional close) — Move close date by 10 business days; we stagger onboarding and training to keep momentum.
3) Option C (contingency) — If Procurement needs extended legal review or SOC evidence, put in a 21-day contingency and use dedicated weekly checkpoints.

Please confirm which option Procurement prefers and whether we should route the SOW for redline now.

Attachments: cost_impact_summary.pdf

Best,
Marcus
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@novacorp.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: updated milestone allocations & approval runway

Jordan / Marcus —

Quick note from Legal: we can produce a redlined SOW within 2 business days of receiving Procurement's comments. For timing sensitivity, please: 

- Share Procurement's redline list in one consolidated attachment (so we avoid back-and-forth).
- If commercial changes are limited to payment timing or liability caps, Legal can propose standard guards that typically close within 3–5 business days.

If Procurement needs custom indemnity language or unusual clauses, that will require escalation and could add additional review time.

Thanks — Neha

Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: FINAL: MAP update — quantification, tradeoffs, and sign-off request [action required]

Jordan / Team —

Summary and immediate asks (summary of thread + next steps):

1) MAP update: attached is the consolidated MAP and a one-page executive summary showing the quantified slip allocation by risk category. If Procurement confirms only the two commercial items (payment timing + cap), we can proceed on the accelerated path.
2) Decision needed: please pick one of the three options below by Wednesday 10 Jun EOD: 
   - A — Maintain close date (choose accelerated demo + expedited legal review).
   - B — Rebaseline close by 10 business days (we will preserve committed onboarding cadence and hold a progress checkpoint weekly).
   - C — Move to 21-day contingency window and trigger weekly executive updates.
3) DocuSign/SOW: If you choose A, we will send the SOW with proposed redlines via DocuSign (link below) for signature within 48 hours of your confirmation. If Procurement wants to redline first, please upload a single consolidated redline to this thread.

Action items for NovaCorp procurement:
- Confirm chosen option by 2026-06-10 EOD (reply to thread).
- If redlining, attach consolidated redline file.

Attachments: proposed_map_v2.xlsx, cost_impact_summary.pdf, redlined_SOW.docx
Related links: https://hubspot.example/deal/NOVA-2026-045, https://docusign.example/sign/NOVA-SOW-045

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.
